featured.title: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
featured.tldr: LARC lets a unified image model think in continuous hidden states instead of text before drawing, trained with a curriculum and a self-supervised information-gain reward, and it improves with more thinking.

featured.title: Intern Lumina U2: A Multi-Codebook Diffusion Large Language Model for Omni-Visual Understanding and Image Generation
featured.tldr: Intern Lumina U2 is a diffusion language model that represents each image position with eight discrete codes, handling image, video and 3D understanding plus image generation and editing in one network trained on Ascend NPUs.

featured.title: PixelUMM: Encoder-Free Unified Image and Video Understanding and Generation
featured.tldr: PixelUMM feeds raw pixel patches and video tubelets through single linear layers into one 8B backbone for image and video understanding and generation, dropping vision encoders and VAEs, at the cost of weaker knowledge-heavy understanding.
